- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.7) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.  
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.7), model underestimates; adjust upward by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (≥ 5% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +2–4% above peak for next 5 days.  
- If model consistently forecasts higher than true outcome over 3–5 days, apply mean reversion: subtract 0.5–1.5% per day from forecast until convergence.  
- If sentiment shifts from positive to negative mid-horizon, reduce forecast slope; model often fails to adjust quickly.  
- For 30-day forecasts, if true outcome is below 5% of 30-day moving average, model tends to overpredict; apply downward bias of 1–2% for next 7 days.
